It is a thin, folded piece, perhaps 3 cm thick. That gives a volume of about 200-250 cm³ at most, but the piece looks loosely folded and partly empty, so I estimate about 200 g. Lasagna runs about 1.5-1.8 kcal/g, so about 200 g comes to roughly 330 kcal.
